walks.name: Downtown Shattuck
walks.vibe: The city's main library, a big bookstore and busy BART crowds.

start.n: Right at the station exit on Shattuck. On Saturdays the farmers market is two blocks west.
start.a: Shattuck Ave and Center St, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: [Unconfirmed] Saturday 10 to 2:30. Walk the stalls and chat, but hand out flyers only if the team has a booked table.
stops.a: Center St and Martin Luther King Jr Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] A big new and used bookstore. Ask if they have a community board or window space.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Open weekdays only, so skip it on a Saturday. They run breathwork and qigong classes. Say hello and ask about a board.
[Address checked Nov 20] A French bistro with a patio. Lunch ends at 2 on weekdays and 3 on weekends.

bonus.n: A green spot by City Hall.
list: 2151 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

walks.name: North Shattuck
walks.vibe: Food co-ops, coffee and a leafy park, busiest on Thursday market afternoons.

start.n: About 10 minutes north of Downtown Berkeley BART. Buses 7 and 18 stop nearby.
start.a: Shattuck Ave and Virginia St, Berkeley, CA 94709

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A yoga studio upstairs. Ask the front desk if they keep a community board for classes and events.
[Address checked Nov 20] The original Peet's, half a block east on Vine. Ask the barista if a flyer can go by the door or on a board.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A worker-owned bakery and cheese shop. Ask a worker where community flyers go.
[Address checked Nov 20] A neighborhood deli that hosts community events. Ask if they have window space.
Sit by the creek under the oaks. YogaKula holds outdoor classes here.

walks.name: Telegraph Avenue
walks.vibe: Bookstores and street life just south of campus.

start.n: Bus 6 runs on Telegraph. Downtown Berkeley BART is a 10 minute walk.
start.a: Telegraph Ave and Bancroft Way, Berkeley, CA 94704

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] An independent bookstore. Opens at 1 on weekends and 12:30 Tue to Fri, closed Mondays. Ask if they post community events.
[Address checked Nov 20] Four floors of books. Ask at the counter about a board or the window.
[Address checked Nov 20] A small bookstore, open daily from 11. Ask if a flyer can go by the door.
Rest stop a few blocks southeast, not a place to post.

bonus.n: About 15 minutes west, a holistic clinic, open weekdays only.

walks.name: South Berkeley and Lorin
walks.vibe: A big grocery, a library and a weekend flea market by BART.

start.n: A 10 minute walk from Ashby BART. The senior center is open weekdays and the flea market weekends, so pick a day.

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A busy independent grocery. Ask at the service desk.

[Verified online Nov 20] Tarea Hall Pittman South Branch, open Sundays too. Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Hours checked Nov 20] Weekends only, 9 to 5, in the Ashby BART lot. Chat with vendors and ask before leaving a flyer.
stops.a: Adeline St and Ashby Ave, Berkeley, CA 94703

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Open Monday to Thursday, 9 to 4, so it can't share a day with the flea market. Ask the front desk where community notices go.
[Address checked Nov 20] A neighborhood bakery in the Lorin District, Wed to Sun, 8 to 3. A break, not a place to post.

bonus.n: A park on the way back.

walks.name: Solano Avenue
walks.vibe: A long, friendly shopping street with small shops and a bookstore.

start.n: At Solano and Peralta. On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Bus 18 runs along Solano.

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] A small German pretzel bakery, open Wed to Sun. Ask if a flyer can go in the window.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A neighborhood grocery. Ask at customer service.
[Address checked Nov 20] An independent bookstore. Ask about the window or a board by the door.
[Address checked Nov 20] Tacos and burritos for a break.

[Verified online Nov 20] A few blocks south on The Alameda. Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.

bonus.n: An optional uphill finish with a bay view, a rest stop only.

walks.name: Elmwood and Ashby
walks.vibe: Bookshops and a branch library on a gentle stroll.

start.n: A small building of studios, two blocks east of Telegraph. On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Bus 6 runs on Telegraph.

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] A literary and garden bookstore. Ask about window space or a board.
[Address checked Nov 20] A bookstore with a small bar. Opens at noon, closed Mondays, and no minors at all, babies included. Ask if they post local events.
A rest stop, not a place to post.

walks.name: Hopkins and Monterey Market
walks.vibe: A beloved produce market, a new cafe and a quiet library.

start.n: Bus 18 stops nearby on Monterey Ave.
start.a: Hopkins St and Monterey Ave, Berkeley, CA 94707

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. A famous independent produce market. Ask staff if there is a spot for community flyers.
[Address checked Nov 20] Open 7 to 5 daily, in the old Espresso Roma spot. Grab a drink and ask about the window.
[Verified online Nov 20] Open Sundays too. Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
Optional, a short walk east. Rest by the creek.

walks.name: San Pablo and University
walks.vibe: Everyday errands, a laundromat and an eco store on a working street.

start.t: University Ave and San Pablo Ave
start.n: Bus 72 runs on San Pablo and bus 51B on University.
start.a: University Ave and San Pablo Ave, Berkeley, CA 94702

stops.n: [Verified online Nov 20] Hand a printed flyer to staff at the desk. Staff review and pin each one for up to 30 days, so a free session isn't a sure yes. Don't pin it up yourself.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Open 7am to 10pm. Ask the attendant first.
A small park two blocks east, on the way south. A rest stop.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12 to 6. Ask staff if they post community notices.

bonus.n: A big park a few blocks south and east, to rest.

walks.name: Fourth Street and Bowl West
walks.vibe: Polished shops, a lagoon walk and a big grocery near the bay.

start.n: Berkeley Amtrak is close by. Bus 51B ends near University and Fourth.
start.a: Fourth St and Hearst Ave, Berkeley, CA 94710

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] A bookstore for design and general readers, open daily. Ask about a board or the window.
Optional and long. Walk the lagoon only if you have time, it's not a place to post.
[Unconfirmed] Last reported inside Tarocco cafe, which is open weekdays 11 to 2:30 only. Ask about posting.
[Address checked Nov 20] Possible board, unconfirmed. Ask at the service desk, then grab a snack at the cafe.

walks.name: Colusa Circle
walks.vibe: A tiny village circle with a bakery and a Sunday market.

start.n: Just north of Solano up Colusa Ave, in Kensington, not Berkeley city. Nubo is closed Sundays, when the market runs, so pick a day.
start.a: Colusa Ave and Oak View Ave, Kensington, CA 94707

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] On the team's sheet for Nov 21. Open Tue to Sat, closed Sundays, so it can't share a day with the market. Say hello and ask about a flyer by the front desk.
[Hours checked Nov 20] Sundays 9 to 2 on Oak View Ave. Chat with the manager about a community table.
stops.a: Oak View Ave and Colusa Ave, Kensington, CA 94707

stops.n: [Address checked Nov 20] The original Semifreddi's shop, open 7 to 3 daily. Grab bread or a cookie and ask about the window.
